hook: ISRO launches *NVS-03*; Modi hails the team
tldr: ISRO's GSLV-F18 launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite. PM Modi congratulated the scientists and engineers.

beats.what: NVS-03 was launched on GSLV-F18, and Modi congratulated ISRO's scientists and engineers.
beats.why: NavIC is back to its minimum four working satellites after this launch.
beats.care: Better homegrown navigation means less dependence on foreign systems for maps, transport and logistics.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat: NavIC was restored to its minimum operational configuration of four satellites on Oct 30. Economic Times: lift-off from Sriharikota's second launch pad at 11.51pm, with the satellite injected into its elliptical orbit after about 18 minutes 40 seconds. The Hindu: ISRO chief Narayanan said the satellite flew with pyro valves open to overcome technical hurdles; NVS-02 (2025) had failed.

cards.q: Should phones and apps in India default to our NavIC over GPS?

cards.why: The Hindu names GSLV-F18 as the launcher.

learn.t: NVS satellites belong to India's own regional navigation system, NavIC.

watch: ISRO's next update on when NVS-03 begins service.
